reason: Review-3 (dc9d6136b) found that the round-2 cluster account does not name the special-point and rank mechanisms that drafts 1603cc54e and 47cc04b28 implement. This amendment names them after the fact; it does not change those drafts and it does not backdate the account. The chronology of the original account and its drafts stays as recorded in review-3.
status: amendment by the maker; independent review required

java_locations: svek/ClusterDotString.java#printInternal (lines 91-99, 146-150): thereALinkFromOrToGroup2 = isThereALinkFromOrToGroup(lines); when true the cluster writes Cluster.getSpecialPointId(group) as a [shape=point,width=.01] node inside the cluster, wrapped in the 'a' and 'i' protection subgraphs when GraphvizVersion.useProtectionWhenThereALinkFromOrToGroup().

svek/ClusterDotString.java#isThereALinkFromOrToGroup (317-323): true when any SvekEdge of the current builder isLinkFromOrTo(cluster.getGroup()); SvekEdges come from DotData.getLinks, which include note links as well as transitions.
rust_locations: crates/rustuml-render/src/state.rs#layout_autonomous_scope: a live cluster keeps its endpoint node (LayoutGraph::add_svek_cluster_endpoint) only when some transition names the group (the id filter at the top of the function); draft 1603cc54e (root path) and 47cc04b28 (inside images).
mechanisms_implemented_but_not_named.known_gap: Rust tests transitions only; Java's isThereALinkFromOrToGroup also counts a note link anchored to the group itself. That case is untested against Java (review-3 bounded obligation 'relay one Java pair for a group whose only link is a note anchored to the group'); it is part of the round-3 relay request.

mechanisms_implemented_but_not_named.mechanism: cluster source/sink ranks for border points
java_locations: svek/ClusterDotString.java#printInternal (134-142): when the cluster has non-NORMAL entity positions, printRanks(RANK_SOURCE, inputs) and printRanks(RANK_SINK, outputs), then the 'ee' subgraph (with the cluster label unless hasPort()).
svek/ClusterDotString.java#printRanks (254-288): '{rank=source|sink; uid;...}' followed by each node's shape; with ports, the entries are chained with arrowhead=none edges to the empty() node.
svek/EntityPosition getInputs/getOutputs: entryPoint/inputPin/expansionInput are inputs, exitPoint/outputPin/expansionOutput are outputs.
rust_locations: crates/rustuml-render/src/state.rs#layout_autonomous_scope (draft 47cc04b28) and render_non_autarkic_root_clusters (draft 1603cc54e): StateEntityPosition::is_input -> LayoutGraph::add_cluster_source_node, is_output -> add_cluster_sink_node, otherwise add_cluster_node.
crates/rustuml-layout/src/graph.rs#graphviz_node_creation_order: a cluster's source-rank and sink-rank nodes are created before its other nodes, as printRanks writes them before printCluster2.
